name: Korean Mewtwo Sealed Battle SR winner prize
short: Korean Mewtwo Sealed Battle SR winner prize

description.text: The winner's prize of the Mewtwo SR sealed battles, the Mewtwo sealed battles played with the enhanced expansion pack Remix Bout, in which each player opened ten packs on site and built a 40-card deck: a Mewtwo-GX 172/SM-P in SR style, of which only 36 were made. The battles ran at authorized card shops from 10 September to mid-October 2019 and at Pokémon Korea's headquarters on 28 September 2019.
